_comment: Per-repo path buckets: the one list of dangerous paths (#642, split per #1708, one reader per #2067). Every reader goes through agents/path_policy.py, whose docstring defines the glob dialect (case-insensitive; `x/**` also matches bare `x`). Adding a new repo MUST NOT require editing any SKILL.md — only this file. Four buckets: `hitl` = identity/security config, a categorical security boundary — any match is /to-tickets class 3 (afk:3-human), hard refusal. `guarded` = shared surfaces with off-repo consumers — any match is /to-tickets class 2 (afk:2-plan), AFK-eligible once a plan locks; for jarvis it is also the plan classifier's shared-surface list (config/plan_review.yaml's class_2.shared_surface_repo points here). No match in either falls through to /to-tickets Q2-Q4 LLM judgement. `machinery` (jarvis only) = the CI/process machinery that decides what merges — workflows, hooks, the classifier and path policy, this file, dependency manifests, the merge-gate docs; /to-tickets ignores it. `gate` (jarvis only) = the code-review gate's own machinery: code_gate_verdict.py posts a gate-machinery red for any PR touching it, so a PR cannot loosen the gate that reviews it. The risk-tier required check (#2004) reads this file from the base commit and floors any PR touching any bucket at HIGH. For jarvis, hitl mirrors the identity/security subset of docs/security/agent-boundaries.md; guarded covers supabase/** (schema is a shared surface per docs/reference/mcp-and-environment.md), whose consumers (redrobot, future jarvis-oss operators) sit outside this repo, and config/repos.conf. (Dropped: `mcp-memory/**` in #1801, root `.mcp.json` in #1800, root `CLAUDE.md` in #1955 — none exists any more.) For redrobot, the research-mode tier-1 safety core (redrobot/driver/**, redrobot/planning/**, redrobot/experiments.py, tests/safety/**, tests/experiments/test_rehearsal_guard.py per decision a7111a44) is guarded, not hitl — redrobot has no hitl entries. Redrobot globs are repo-relative and carry the `redrobot/` package prefix.

SergazyNarynov/redrobot._comment: Guarded == research-mode tier 1 (safety core) per decision a7111a44. Globs are repo-relative to the redrobot checkout, so the safety-critical package paths carry the `redrobot/` package prefix (`redrobot/driver/**`, not `driver/**`) — a bare prefix matched no real path and made Q1 fail-open for redrobot (#1684). `mujoco/**` was dropped: MuJoCo now lives under `assets/` + `redrobot/simulation/` (no top-level `mujoco/`), and simulation is tier 2 (measurement instrument) guarded by mandatory golden/replay tests, not the plan gate.
